info.name: Backend API (Complete)
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the Express ecommerce backend. All listed endpoints are implemented. Use mock SMS (SMS_PROVIDER=mock) locally; OTP appears in the server console as [otp-dev] phone=... otp=...... Also run: npm run test:e2e

Auth: none (public)
No OTP/PIN at checkout.
Body: { phone, name?, paymentMethod?: "COD", items[{ productId, skuId, quantity }], address{ fullName, phone?, addressLine1, city, postalCode, ... } }.
Delivery ZIP must be in the allowed NoVA/DC/South MD list. Finds/creates User by phone (guest registry). Response: order (placedAsGuest, matchedExistingAccount, risk), smsAlert, customer { hasPin, postOrderCta: register|login }.
Rate limit: >10 orders/hour → 429 code ORDER_PHONE_BLOCKED + blockedUntil + try-again message.
Does not clear authenticated server cart / does not break POST /api/cart/merge.
